intro: Skirmish at Echo Ridge is a direct military operation ordered by Marshal McBride to cleanse the Echo Ridge Mine of kobold laborers. Following initial reconnaissance, this strike aims to prevent the subterranean infestation from establishing a permanent foothold in Northshire Valley.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging. Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.
Waste no time, friend. The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I know it's bloody work, friend, but it's vital to the safety of Northshire. Are you ready to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army. There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them. We have further tasks for you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
